title: Landing Page Load and Content Verification
description: Verify that the landing page loads successfully and displays hero section, featured prompts, testimonials, and call-to-action sections correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to the landing page URL
Check that the hero section is visible with expected text and images
Verify featured prompts are displayed with preview images, titles, and categories
Confirm that the testimonials section is present and populated
Check the presence and functionality of call-to-action buttons

title: Explore Page Search and Filter Functionality
description: Ensure the Explore page search and filtering features return accurate and relevant prompt results based on category, tag, style, subject, and mood queries.

steps.description: Navigate to the Explore page
Enter a valid search keyword into the search input
Apply multiple filters such as category, tag, and mood
Check that the prompt grid updates and displays results matching the search and filter criteria
Clear filters and verify that all prompts are displayed again
Verify that the filters handle edge cases such as no matching results gracefully

title: Prompt Detail Page Display and Copy Functionality
description: Validate that the prompt detail page correctly displays full prompt text, preview images, and that the one-click copy to clipboard function works without requiring signup.

steps.description: From the Explore page, select a prompt to navigate to its detail page
Verify the full prompt text is displayed accurately
Check that preview images load properly and correspond to the prompt
Click the one-click copy button
Confirm the prompt text is copied to clipboard and a confirmation toast notification appears
Ensure this functionality works without user authentication

title: User Sign-up and Login Flow
description: Verify user sign-up and login flows function correctly, including successful authentication and redirection to protected pages.

steps.description: Navigate to the sign-up page
Enter valid registration information and submit
Confirm account creation success and automatic login
Log out of the application
Navigate to the login page and enter valid credentials
Confirm successful login and access to authenticated user features
Attempt to access an admin-only route as a normal user
Verify access is denied or redirected appropriately

title: Saved Prompts Management for Authenticated Users
description: Ensure authenticated users can save prompts, search within saved prompts, and remove prompts from their favorites collection.

steps.description: Log in as an authenticated user
On the Explore page, save a prompt to favorites
Navigate to the Saved Prompts page
Verify the saved prompt appears in the list
Use the search function to find the saved prompt
Confirm search results match query against saved prompts
Remove a saved prompt from the collection
Verify the prompt is removed and no longer appears in saved list

title: Prompt Submission Form Validation and Workflow
description: Validate that the prompt submission form enforces input validation, submits data correctly, and that prompts appear in admin review queue requiring approval before public display.

steps.description: Navigate to the Submit Prompt page
Attempt to submit the form with missing required fields
Verify appropriate validation errors are displayed preventing submission
Complete the form with valid prompt information and submit
Confirm submission success message and form reset
Log in as admin user and navigate to the prompt review queue
Check that the newly submitted prompt is listed for review
Approve the submitted prompt
Verify the prompt status updates to published and appears publicly

title: Blog Post Management Workflow
description: Ensure admins can create, edit, schedule, and publish blog posts using the rich text editor with SEO metadata without errors.

steps.description: Log in as admin and navigate to blog management
Create a new blog post with title, body content via rich text editor, SEO metadata, and publish date
Confirm the blog post saves successfully as a draft or scheduled post
Edit an existing blog post and update content and SEO metadata
Verify that updates are saved and displayed correctly
Publish the blog post
Check the blog post is visible on the public blog page with accurate content and metadata

title: Admin Dashboard Prompt, Category, and Tag Management
description: Verify admin users can create, edit, and delete prompts, categories, and tags with immediate data consistency and updated analytics.

steps.description: Log in as admin and open the Admin Dashboard
Create a new prompt with full required metadata
Confirm the prompt is added and visible in prompt listings
Edit an existing category's metadata including icon, color, and description
Verify changes are saved and reflected in both admin and public interfaces
Modify tags including alias normalization to merge duplicates
Ensure tags are consistently normalized across prompts
Delete a prompt and confirm removal
Verify prompt no longer appears publicly or in admin listings

title: Discovery Events and Link Tracking Analytics
description: Validate that prompt discovery event tracking and short link analytics collect, store, and display data correctly within the admin interface and Google Analytics integration.

steps.description: As a user, discover prompts via search, filters, and related prompts
Click on tracked short links with UTM parameters
Log in as admin and navigate to the analytics dashboard
Verify that discovery events are logged and visible with accurate counts and details
Confirm link click metrics are accurate and UTM parameters are recorded
Check Google Analytics data is fetched and displayed correctly

title: Theme Switching and System Preference Detection
description: Test that the dark/light theme switching honors user system preference and allows manual toggling with immediate UI updates.

steps.description: Set system theme preference to dark mode
Load the website and observe initial theme
Verify the site loads in dark theme matching system preference
Use the theme toggle switch to change to light theme
Confirm theme switches to light mode instantly
Toggle back to dark theme manually
Verify UI updates reflect dark mode without page reload

title: Cookie Consent Banner Display and Preference Persistence
description: Verify that the cookie consent banner is displayed according to GDPR rules and stores user consent preferences correctly.

steps.description: Clear browser cookies and local storage
Load the website in a GDPR jurisdiction simulated environment
Check that the cookie consent banner is visible
Accept or decline cookie consent
Verify that consent preference is stored and banner is dismissed
Reload the page
Confirm that the cookie consent banner does not reappear after preference is set

title: Contact Form Submission and Admin Message Management
description: Ensure that users can submit inquiries via the contact form with location tracking and that admins can view and manage these messages.

steps.description: Navigate to the Contact page
Fill in required contact form fields with valid data and submit
Confirm submission success notification is displayed
Log in as admin and go to Contact Messages management
Verify the newly submitted message appears with correct details including location
Mark a message as read or delete it
Confirm updated message status or removal from list

title: Navigation Responsiveness and Accessibility Compliance
description: Verify navigation elements function smoothly across devices and meet WCAG accessibility standards.

steps.description: Browse main navigation on desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports
Confirm navigation menus open and close smoothly with animations
Verify keyboard navigation and focus states are present and visually clear
Check that screen readers announce navigation items correctly

title: Legal Pages Accessibility and Content Accuracy
description: Ensure legal pages (terms of service, privacy policy, cookie policy, refund policy) load correctly, display up-to-date policy content, and are accessible.

steps.description: Navigate to each legal page from the footer links
Verify each page loads without error and displays the complete content
Check pages are accessible with appropriate headings and readable for screen readers
Confirm links within legal content, if any, function correctly

title: FAQ and Guidelines Pages Content and Navigation
description: Validate that FAQ and Guidelines pages are available, display relevant information clearly, and navigation between questions or sections works correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to the FAQ page
Check FAQ entries are displayed with expandable answers
Use the floating FAQ button and verify it opens the FAQ content overlay
Confirm toggling FAQ answers expands and collapses correctly
Navigate to the Guidelines page
Verify the submission guidelines content is complete and readable
